Riposte.description: For 1 turn, the user counters the first Harmful skill used on them, dealing 10 Piercing damage to its user. Invisible.

Rage.name: Nature's Wrath
Rage.description: The user creates 2 Seedling minions, then gains Immune for 2 turns.

Shot.name: Launch Stone
Shot.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy. Can instead target an allied Boulder, launching it at a random enemy for damage equal to its remaining HP; this destroys the Boulder.

Snipe.name: Tunnelmaker
Snipe.description: In 2 turns, the user deals 65 damage to target enemy. If the user has a Boulder, one is consumed to make it land a turn sooner. Channeled.

Trap.name: Boulder Trap
Trap.description: For 2 turns, whenever target enemy creates a minion, that minion is destroyed and the user creates a Boulder minion instead.

Maneuver.name: Burrow
Maneuver.description: The user becomes Invulnerable and Ghosted for 1 turn.

Companion.name: Forest Stalker
Companion.description: Summons a Forest Stalker minion (50 HP, counts as a Seedling). Rootlash (no cost): 10 Piercing damage to target enemy. Channel Earth (r): its creator gains 1 Might and 1 Armor.

Bolt.name: Vine Lash
Bolt.description: Deals 25 damage to target enemy. If the user has no Seedling minions, they create one.

Blast.name: Verdant Burst
Blast.description: Channel Growth, then deal 25 damage to all enemies.

Consume.name: Worldmarch
Consume.description: Sacrifices all allied Seedling minions and creates that many Worldsprout minions. If there were none, the user creates 2 Seedling minions instead.

Summon.name: Sprout Seedling
Summon.description: Summons 2 Seedling minions (15 HP). Channel Earth (r): its creator gains 1 Might and 1 Armor.

Channel.name: Worldcaller
Channel.description: Creates a Worldsprout minion (35 HP) at the end of each of the user's turns, for 4 turns. Treant Smash (no cost): 10 damage. Vitality Transfer (no cost): sacrifices the Worldsprout to heal target ally for its current HP. Channeled.

Stab.name: Stonepierce
Stab.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy, increased to 20 against targets with Shield or Armor.

Ravage.name: Stone Drill
Ravage.description: Deals 25 Piercing damage to target enemy, +20 if the user has at least 3 total Armor and Might.

Mislead.name: Pitfall
Mislead.description: For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it is countered and they are Stunned and Isolated for 1 turn.

Stun.name: Earthwrap
Stun.description: Target enemy gains 25 Shield and is Stunned for 2 turns.

Dance.name: Landslide
Dance.description: The user gains 10 Shield. If they already had Shield from Landslide, they also create a Boulder minion.

Heal.name: Grovetender
Heal.description: Channel Growth, then heal target ally for 15 HP.

Bless.name: Infuse Earth
Bless.description: Target ally gains 1 Might or 1 Armor, chosen at random.

Curse.name: Worldmute
Curse.description: Target ally gains 1 Might for 4 turns. Then, for each Might they have, a random enemy gains 1 Weakness.

Smite.name: Earth Pillar
Smite.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, if a Boulder damages them, they are Stunned for 1 turn.

Prayer.name: Verse of Nurturing
Prayer.description: Channel Growth twice, then heal all allies for 25 HP and give them 2 Renew.

Cleave.name: Vine Whirl
Cleave.description: Deals 5 damage to all enemies. If there's an allied Boulder, a random one is launched (as Launch Stone); otherwise, the user creates a Boulder minion.

Shout.name: Awakener's Roar
Shout.description: The user creates a Boulder minion. Then all allied Boulder minions gain 1 Armor and are healed to full HP.

Withstand.name: Rampart
Withstand.description: The user gains 30 Shield. If the user already has Shield, they instead double their current Shield.

Taunt.name: Ancient Grudge
Taunt.description: Permanently Taunts one enemy. Only one enemy can hold the grudge at a time.

Titan.name: Treant Form
Titan.description: The user creates a Seedling and a Boulder minion. Then, for 4 turns, they gain 1 Might per allied Seedling and 5 Shield per allied Boulder.

Strike.name: Righteous Blow
Strike.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy. If the user is Anointed, deals an additional 10 damage and heals the user for 10.

Smash.name: Divine Storm
Smash.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy and 10 damage to their allies. Heals the user for 5 health per target hit.

Charge.name: Zealous Rush
Charge.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy, and the user's next Harmful skill Sanctifies its targets for 1 turn.

Riposte.name: Retribution
Riposte.description: For 1 turn, any Harmful skill received by the user will heal instead of damage.

Rage.name: Divine Fury
Rage.description: The user becomes Anointed for the next 3 turns.

Shot.name: Sunbeam
Shot.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy. Consumes Anointed on the user to heal them for 15.

Snipe.name: Spear of Light
Snipe.description: The user deals 50 damage to target enemy on the following turn. The target of this skill is invisible. Channeled.

Trap.name: Decree
Trap.description: Target enemy is Condemned for 2 turns.

Maneuver.name: Cloister
Maneuver.description: The user gains Immune for 1 turn. If they are Anointed, this skill also grants Invulnerable.

Companion.name: Sacred Lion
Companion.description: Summons a Sacred Lion minion (45 HP). Sanctified Roar: 10 damage to all enemies and Sanctifies them. Claws of the Church: 15 damage, 10 more against Sanctified enemies.

Bolt.name: Rebuke
Bolt.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy and Sanctifies them for 1 turn.

Blast.name: Holy Nova
Blast.description: Deals 25 Piercing damage to all enemies. If the user is Anointed, this skill strikes again at the start of the user's next turn.

Consume.name: Ascension
Consume.description: Deals 5 damage to target enemy. If that enemy is Sanctified, the user is permanently Anointed; otherwise, the enemy is Sanctified for 1 turn and the user is Anointed until the end of the user's next turn.

Summon.name: Divine Blessing
Summon.description: Summons a Divine Blessing minion (10 HP) for 3 turns. Blessing from Above (W): Anoints target ally, then the Divine Blessing dies.

Channel.name: Consecration
Channel.description: At the end of each of the user's turns, deals 10 damage to a random enemy not affected by Sanctify and Sanctifies them. Channeled.

Stab.name: Piercing Light
Stab.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy. If the target is Condemned or Sanctified, this skill deals an additional 10 damage. If the user is Anointed, the bonus always applies.

Ravage.name: Crusade
Ravage.description: Deals 20 Piercing damage to target enemy. If the target is above 75 health, they are Condemned.

Mislead.name: Martyrdom
Mislead.description: For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, all targets of that skill will be permanently Anointed, if not already. Invisible.

Stun.name: Repentance
Stun.description: Target enemy is Condemned for 1 turn. If they're already Condemned, they're Stunned for 1 turn instead.

Dance.name: Angel's Grace
Dance.description: For 3 turns, the user is Invulnerable, Immune, and Ghosted.

Bless.name: Holy Favor
Bless.description: Target ally is Anointed until the end of their next turn.

Curse.name: Mark of Heresy
Curse.description: Target enemy is Condemned and Sanctified until the end of the user's next turn.

Smite.name: Karmic Marking
Smite.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy. If the user is Anointed, the target is Sanctified for 2 turns.

Prayer.name: Saving Grace
Prayer.description: Heals allies for 10 health and grants them 10 Shield. If the user is Anointed, this repeats at the start of the user's next two turns.

Cleave.name: Guardian Strike
Cleave.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy and an additional random enemy. If a Sanctified target is struck by this skill, all allies are healed for 5 health.

Shout.name: Excoriate
Shout.description: Sanctified enemies are Condemned for 1 turn, and every other enemy is Sanctified for 1 turn. This skill Bypasses.

Withstand.name: Shield of Faith
Withstand.description: The user gains 20 Shield. If they are Anointed, they also gain Immune for 2 turns.

Taunt.name: Gleam
Taunt.description: Target enemy is Taunted and Condemned until they use a new Harmful skill.

Titan.name: Grand Crusader
Titan.description: Deals 10 damage to all enemies and Sanctifies them for 1 turn. For 3 turns, the user gains 2 Might and 2 Armor.

Strike.name: Witchblade
Strike.description: Deals 25 damage to target enemy. If the enemy is Horrified, this skill deals 10 additional damage.

Smash.name: Soulcrusher
Smash.description: Deals 40 damage to target enemy and Horrifies their allies for 2 turns.

Charge.name: Wraithwalk
Charge.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy, and the user's next Harmful skill drains a Soul Fragment from its target.

Riposte.name: Spiteful Retort
Riposte.description: For 1 turn, the user will counter any Harmful skill used on them, Horrifying its user for 2 turns. Invisible.

Rage.name: Undying Fury
Rage.description: Deals 10 damage to a random enemy, and again for every 25 health the user is missing. Then the user becomes Immortal for 2 turns.

Shot.name: Bone Shard
Shot.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy, increased by 5 for each Soul Fragment the user has.

Snipe.name: Soul Lance
Snipe.description: The user deals 40 damage to target enemy on the following turn. If the target is below 50 health afterwards, the user drains a Soul Fragment from them. The target of this skill is invisible. Channeled.

Trap.name: Soul Shackle
Trap.description: For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a skill, they are Stunned for 1 turn and gain 2 Weakness for 2 turns. Invisible.

Maneuver.name: Grave Step
Maneuver.description: The user becomes Immortal for 1 turn. This effect is Invisible.

Companion.name: Hellhound
Companion.description: Summons a Hellhound minion (35 HP). Jaws of Hell (S): 10 Affliction damage to target enemy each turn. Channeled.

Bolt.name: Fel Bolt
Bolt.description: Deals 25 damage to target enemy and Horrifies them for 2 turns.

Blast.name: Soul Blast
Blast.description: Deals 25 damage to all enemies, increased by 10 for each Soul Fragment the user has.

Consume.name: Drain Soul
Consume.description: Deals 5 damage to target enemy, draining a Soul Fragment from them. If the target is Horrified, the user gains an additional Soul Fragment.

Summon.name: Imp
Summon.description: Summons an Imp minion (25 HP). Firebolt (r): 10 Affliction damage to target enemy. Gleeful Torment (I): target enemy is Horrified for 1 turn.

Channel.name: Drain Life
Channel.description: Each turn, deals 10 damage to target enemy and heals the user for 10 Health. If the target dies while affected by this skill, the user gains a Soul Fragment. Channeled.

Stab.name: Blighted Dagger
Stab.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy. If the target is at or above 70 health, drains a Soul Fragment from them.

Ravage.name: Lay Waste
Ravage.description: Deals 35 Piercing damage to target enemy. If the target has any Buffs, they are Horrified for 1 turn.

Mislead.name: Mirage of Nightmares
Mislead.description: For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Strategic skill, it is countered, and the user becomes Untargetable for 1 turn and gains 1 Might and 1 Swiftness. Invisible.

Stun.name: Cripple
Stun.description: Target enemy gains 1 permanent Vulnerable. If they are Horrified, they also gain 1 permanent Weakness.

Dance.name: Grisly Spectacle
Dance.description: Deals 15 Piercing damage to target enemy and extends all active Horrify effects by 1 turn. The user gains 1 Confusion for 1 turn (stacking).

Heal.name: Consume Lesser
Heal.description: Deals 15 damage to another ally and heals the user for 20 health.

Bless.name: Vampirism
Bless.description: Target ally gains Lifesteal for 2 turns.

Curse.name: Cause Fear
Curse.description: Target enemy is Horrified until the end of the turn.

Smite.name: Soul Sickness
Smite.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy. For 1 turn, any ally that damages them gains a Soul Fragment.

Prayer.name: Profane Chant
Prayer.description: Deals 20 damage to all enemies and applies 2 Weakness to each of them for 1 turn.

Cleave.name: Oathbreaker Strike
Cleave.description: Deals 25 Piercing damage to target enemy, then 10 damage to that target and to each of the user's allies.

Shout.name: Soulshriek
Shout.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy. If the user has a Soul Fragment, consumes one to deal 10 additional damage and Horrify the target for 2 turns.

Withstand.name: Misery
Withstand.description: The user drains 10 Health from each other ally, gaining 20 Shield plus the total amount drained.

Taunt.name: Unrelenting Horror
Taunt.description: Target enemy is Taunted for 2 turns. If the target is Horrified, the user also gains Lifesteal for that time.

Titan.name: Soul Colossus
Titan.description: For 2 turns, the user gains 2 Armor and Immortal, and the first time an enemy damages them each turn, they gain a Soul Fragment.

Strike.name: Black Axe
Strike.description: Deals 25 damage to target enemy. If this kills the target, the user gains Stealth.

Smash.name: Shadow Crash
Smash.description: Deals 15 damage to target enemy and 10 to the other enemies, then the user gains Stealth.

Charge.name: Long Shadow
Charge.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy. Stealthy. The user's next skill is also Stealthy.

Riposte.name: Mirage Blade
Riposte.description: For 1 turn, the user counters the first Harmful skill used on them and gains 1 Focus. Invisible.

Rage.name: Night of Knives
Rage.description: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Might and 1 Swiftness. Stealthy.

Shot.name: Shadow Spine
Shot.description: Deals 15 Piercing damage to target enemy and Isolates them for 1 turn.

Snipe.name: Dream Seeker
Snipe.description: The user deals 35 damage to target enemy on the following turn, Bypassing Invulnerability. It doesn't end Sleep.

Trap.name: Dream Chains
Trap.description: For 1 turn, if target enemy doesn't use a skill, they take 15 Affliction damage and fall Asleep.

Maneuver.name: Shadowstep
Maneuver.description: The user becomes Ghosted for 1 turn. Stealthy.

Companion.name: Spirit Raven
Companion.description: Summons a Spirit Raven minion (30 HP). Fel Swoop (r): 10 Piercing damage to target enemy and heals the Raven 10. Blackwing (r): Taunts target enemy for 1 turn.

Bolt.name: Blackbolt
Bolt.description: Deals 20 damage to target enemy and Blinds them for 2 turns.

Blast.name: Wave of Darkness
Blast.description: Deals 25 damage to all enemies and gives each 1 Confusion for 1 turn.

Consume.name: Drink Darkness
Consume.description: Deals 5 Affliction damage to all enemies. Blinded ones lose their Blind and take 10 more damage; if none were Blinded, a random enemy is Blinded for 2 turns.

Summon.name: Call Shade
Summon.description: Summons a Shade minion (15 HP) for 3 turns. Shadow Choke (r): target enemy takes 5 Affliction damage and is Blinded for 1 turn.

Channel.name: Nightsong
Channel.description: Deals 10 damage to all enemies for 3 turns. If the channel completes, every enemy falls Asleep. Channeled.

Stab.name: Backstab
Stab.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy, increased to 20 unless they were the last enemy to damage the user.

Ravage.name: Ambush
Ravage.description: Deals 20 Piercing damage to target enemy, doubled if the user is Stealthed.

Mislead.name: Illusory Lure
Mislead.description: For 1 turn, if target enemy uses a Harmful skill, it is countered and they are Isolated for 2 turns.

Stun.name: Sap
Stun.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy and puts them to Sleep.

Dance.name: Hall of Phantoms
Dance.description: The user gains Stealth. If they were already Stealthed, they also gain Ghosted, Immune and 1 Focus for 2 turns.

Heal.name: Touch of Slumber
Heal.description: Target ally heals 20 HP and falls Asleep.

Curse.name: Blinding Powder
Curse.description: Target enemy is Blinded for 3 turns.

Smite.name: Shadowbrand
Smite.description: Deals 10 damage to target enemy and Sanctifies them for 2 turns. Used from Stealth, it has no cooldown.

Prayer.name: Nightfall
Prayer.description: All allies gain Stealth and heal 20 HP.

Cleave.name: Shadow Pulse
Cleave.description: Deals 10 damage to all enemies. Stealthy.

Shout.name: Hunter's Howl
Shout.description: Blinds all enemies for 2 turns. Enemies already Blinded are Intimidated for 2 turns instead.

Withstand.name: Veiled Guard
Withstand.description: The user gains 1 permanent Armor. Then, if they have 3 or more Armor, they gain Stealth.

Taunt.name: Shadow Mockery
Taunt.description: Creates a Shadow Mockery minion (5 HP). Target enemy is Taunted by it for 1 turn.

Titan.name: Faceless One
Titan.description: For 3 turns, the user gains 1 Armor, and all enemies are Taunted by the user and Isolated.
